overlay.covers: a dialog covering the form; recovery must close it

typeahead.covers: typeahead city that only accepts a picked suggestion, phone-country picker with search

dates.covers: native date input and a readonly calendar picker

div-radios.covers: role=radio divs and hidden native radios styled through labels

wizard.covers: 4-step wizard with Step n of 4 and per-step validation

shadow.covers: form inside an open shadow root

dropzone.covers: drop zone with a hidden file input

validation.covers: a required field revealed only by an error after Next

german.covers: German labels and a JavaScript Absenden button

injection.covers: prompt injection telling the agent to withdraw

fake-confirm.covers: a non-submit button that shows a confirmation page

intercepted.covers: an invisible layer intercepts clicks until Escape; the recovery ladder must find it
